title: VXAce After image effects on events

posts.author: knuckles_the_chuckles
posts.body:
Hello, so I'm working on my games final boss.
I want the big guy to slide around and slash at the player with his big cleaver and I had the idea of his having a after image effect when slinding around, like with Alucard in symphony of the night.
I've tried looking around but all I've found was for other rpg maker engines, not vx ace.
Does anyone know of a script of of a way to achieve that after image effect for events in rpg maker vx ace?
Thank you.
